get.description: Per-club settings the SPA needs before login (all come from environment variables).

post.description: Change your own password (also how a temporary password is replaced). Needs the current password.
CSV: sail,name[,design,skipper,club,email,phone,fleet] plus one column per rating type code.

put.description: Replace the entry list. Boats with recorded finishes can't be removed.

post.description: Add (or update) one boat's entry, e.g. a boat joining a single race on the day.
A standalone race that is not part of a series (stored as a one-race 'single' series).
Season rollover: copy setup, entry list and a shifted schedule, but no results.

put.description: Create or update a fleet's start. Changing course/rating type re-resolves ratings.

post.description: Record (or correct) a payment. Amount defaults to the series fee, or the race fee for one race.

get.description: Which boats belong on which fleet's panel for this race: a boat sits in the start it raced in.

post.description:
Put a boat in another fleet, for this race only or for the rest of the series.

Earlier results stay in the starts where the boat actually raced; only this race's result moves
(when asked), and its rating is re-resolved for the new start.

delete.description:
Clear a boat's result in this race; optionally take it out of the series entirely.

Removing the entry is refused while the boat has results in other races. Payments are kept.

PublicBoat.description: Only boat, sail number, design and skipper are ever public.
